name: Create Damage Request
overview: [excited] Let's create a Damage Request! Think of this... as logging damaged linen. [friendly] We just link it to a Customer's Order or a Laundry Wash Fulfillment. Let's get started!

nodes.label: Item Damage Request Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] When was the damage reported? Just pick the date.

nodes.label: Source Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] Where did this happen? An ORDER for a customer... or a WASH_FULFILLMENT for a laundry vendor? Let's pick ORDER.

nodes.label: Search Customer
nodes.explanation: [casual] Search for the customer involved. Let's use... Charan.

nodes.label: Order Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This automatically loads their orders for that day.

nodes.label: Select Order
nodes.explanation: [casual] Which specific order is this for? If there's only one, it auto-fills!

nodes.label: Notes / Description
nodes.explanation: [casual] What EXACTLY happened? Jot down the damage details here.

nodes.label: Product
nodes.explanation: [casual] Which product got damaged? Pick it from the list.

nodes.label: Quantity
nodes.explanation: [casual] How many items were damaged? Just the number.

nodes.label: Price
nodes.explanation: [casual] And what's the price per item? This helps with billing adjustments.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] We logged the damage request. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go report a REAL issue. You've got this!
description: Walkthrough for creating a new damage request
